question: Based on the World Bank global population dataset and the World Bank health nutrition population dataset, how many countries experienced an increase of more than 1% from the previous year to 2018 in both their total population and per capita current health expenditure (PPP)?
sql:
WITH pop_data AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    year_2017,
    year_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(year_2018 - year_2017, year_2017) * 100 AS pop_growth_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country`
  WHERE year_2017 IS NOT NULL AND year_2018 IS NOT NULL AND year_2017 > 0
    AND country_code NOT IN (
      'LMC', 'LIC', 'EAR', 'WLD', 'SST', 'MEA', 'TEA', 'SAS', 'HIC', 'ECS', 'CSS', 'NAC', 
      'AFE', 'AFW', 'OED', 'OEC', 'TCA', 'Z76', 'Z86', 'Z88', 'Z89', 'Z90', 'Z91', 'Z92', 
      'Z93', 'Z94', 'Z95', 'Z96', 'Z97', 'Z98', 'Z99', 'HPC', 'SSF', 'ARB', 'OSS', 'PRE', 'EMU'
    )
),
health_data AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN value END) AS health_2017,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2018 THEN value END) AS health_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND year IN (2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY country_code
),
health_growth AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(health_2018 - health_2017, health_2017) * 100 AS health_growth_pct
  FROM health_data
  WHERE health_2017 IS NOT NULL AND health_2018 IS NOT NULL AND health_2017 > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM pop_data p
JOIN health_growth h ON p.country_code = h.country_code
WHERE p.pop_growth_pct > 1 AND h.health_growth_pct > 1
